title: Unit 8 Quiz — That's Really Interesting!
subtitle: Assessment after Unit 8 · v1 · 14 slides · ExamView L4U8 · how the quiz runs → what the app marks (40) and what Neritan marks (10) → the full answer key Q1–Q35 → the Q36 writing rubric → the Q37 speaking script with its picture → reading the result by skill

content: Administer the ExamView Unit 8 quiz: play TR 8.1 for Q1 and TR 8.2 for Q31–35, and run the Q37 speaking prompts from the video-game picture.
Mark the two open responses — the Q36 writing and the Q37 speaking — and any sentence in Q8–22 whose wording the key did not predict.
Read the result by skill (vocabulary 12 · grammar 15 · reading 8 · listening 5 · writing 5 · speaking 5) and pick what to re-teach.
language: Check who joining two sentences, with the verb agreeing: a grandmother who loves to cook.
Check the two object patterns: sent a letter to me, made a cake for them — to with send, show, give; for with make, buy.
Check the hobby and video-game vocabulary: alone, avatar, compete, controller, cooperate, score.
Check for example and such as in the writing.
